<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 10+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Wand of Chromatic Burst](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2273)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=100" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Wand" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=164" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 138 <sup>1.1</sup>

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This intricately carved quartz wand changes color, cycling through the colors of the rainbow.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_chromatic armor_](/Spells.aspx?ID=881) of the indicated level. Additionally, the target can use the Chromatic Armor Burst action.

 **Chromatic Armor Burst** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)); **Requirements** You're affected by _chromatic armor_ created by the _wand of chromatic burst_; **Effect** Choose one color of the _chromatic armor_ the wand created for you. The spell ends and light of that color flashes brightly in a 20-foot emanation. Creatures in the area take damage of the type associated with the color you chose, with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your spell DC; the amount of damage depends on the wand's type. This action has the trait corresponding to the damage type you chose.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of _chromatic armor_ of the appropriate level.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
